description: Source code for a decrypting media decoder implementation using Windows Media Foundation APIs, including DRM handling and sample processing.

classes.name: DecryptingDecoder
classes.description: A media decoder that handles decryption and decoding of encrypted media samples using Windows Media Foundation.

methods.name: CreateSample
methods.description: Creates an IMFMediaSample from raw data and timestamp.

methods.name: AttachDrmDataToSample
methods.description: Attaches DRM-related data such as key ID, IV, and subsample mapping to an IMFMediaSample.

methods.name: TryWriteInputBuffer
methods.description: Processes an input buffer, possibly decrypting it, and writes it to the decoder.

methods.name: ProcessAndRead
methods.description: Attempts to read processed samples from the decoder, handling decryption output if necessary.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Drains the decoder and decryptor pipelines.

methods.name: ActivateDecryptor
methods.description: Configures and activates the decryptor, setting input/output types and protection.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder and decryptor state.
